lines.text: On one of the inside pages, an in-depth report on crime reveals that, although the overall crime rate has dropped only 4% over the last decade, public perception is that crime has fallen much further. The report attributes this perception to three points: Violent crime has decreased much faster than other types of crime, and is down by 15% from ten years ago. Crime in the schools, which has always gotten the most publicity, has dropped by 40%. Most importantly, offenders are getting harsher sentences, as opposed to the old days of getting off on technicalities, low bail, and easy parole.
